title: The held world's widest zoom-out, before and after its own pixels
question: Zooming all the way out in the druid game. Which reads better? The lab and the sandbox have looked like one of these since 2026-09-13; this game was still drawing the other one.
context_md: Rung 4 (the widest stop), same world, same camera, same Coverage filter. Window 1024x640. Buffers: 512x320 against 1024x640, both shown at the same physical size exactly as the window scales them. Cells discarded per pixel: 15 of 16 against 3 of 4. Whole-frame cost measured in the sandbox: 1.29x at x2, 1.66x at x4, and nothing at all at play zoom. Default is x4 in all three games now; at a bigger window this pane would be finer again.

items.label: x1 - what shipped until today: 16 world cells per screen pixel
x4 asked for, x2 at this window: 4 world cells per screen pixel
